title.en: To be worth doing / To be doable (-(으)ㄹ 만하다)

sentences.target: -(으)ㄹ 만하다는 어떤 행동이나 상황이 시도할 가치가 있거나 가능성이 있음을 나타낸다.
sentences.en: The form -(으)ㄹ 만하다 indicates that an action or situation is worth trying or is reasonably possible.

sentences.target: 긍정적인 평가를 전달할 때 자주 쓰인다.
sentences.en: It is often used to express a positive evaluation.

sentences.target: '할 만하다'는 '충분히 해볼 가치가 있다' 또는 '그 정도면 괜찮다'는 뉘앙스다.
sentences.en: Saying something ‘is worth doing’ implies that it has enough value or quality to try.

sentences.target: 상대에게 추천하거나 의견을 제시할 때 자연스럽다.
sentences.en: It sounds natural when giving advice or recommendations.

sentences.target: 부정문에서는 '~할 만하지 않다'처럼 기대에 못 미침을 표현할 수 있다.
sentences.en: In negative sentences, it can mean that something is not worth the effort or expectation.

sentences.target: 일상 대화뿐 아니라 글에서도 비교적 자주 사용된다.
sentences.en: It is used frequently in both spoken and written Korean.

sentences.target: 주어가 경험을 기반으로 판단을 내릴 때 적절하다.
sentences.en: It fits well when the speaker is making a judgment based on personal experience.

sentences.target: 감탄, 평가, 조언 여러 문맥에서 활용 가능한 범위가 넓은 표현이다.
sentences.en: It can be used for admiration, evaluation, or offering an opinion.

sentences.target: 경험적 판단을 강조하기 때문에 과장된 표현과는 잘 어울리지 않는다.
sentences.en: Because it is based on experience, it does not pair well with exaggerated expressions.

sentences.target: 맛, 장소, 활동, 난이도, 사람 평가 등 다양한 내용에 적용될 수 있다.
sentences.en: It can apply to food, places, activities, difficulty levels, people, and many other topics.

sentences.target: 이 음식은 먹어 볼 만해.
sentences.en: This food is worth trying.

sentences.target: 그 영화는 볼 만했어.
sentences.en: The movie was worth watching.

sentences.target: 그 책은 읽을 만해.
sentences.en: That book is worth reading.

sentences.target: 그곳은 한 번 가 볼 만해.
sentences.en: That place is worth visiting once.

sentences.target: 이 문제는 해결할 만해.
sentences.en: This problem is solvable.

sentences.target: 그 사람은 믿을 만해.
sentences.en: He is someone you can trust.

sentences.target: 날씨가 좋아서 걷기 좋을 만해.
sentences.en: The weather is nice, so it’s worth taking a walk.

sentences.target: 가격이 괜찮아서 살 만해.
sentences.en: The price is reasonable, so it’s worth buying.

sentences.target: 힘들긴 하지만 도전해 볼 만해.
sentences.en: It’s tough, but it’s worth trying.

sentences.target: 그 정도면 참아 줄 만해.
sentences.en: At that level, it’s something you can endure.

sentences.target: 기다릴 만한 가치가 있어.
sentences.en: It’s worth the wait.

sentences.target: 조금 배워 보면 따라 할 만해.
sentences.en: If you learn a little, you can follow along.

sentences.target: 조용하고 분위기가 좋아서 추천할 만해.
sentences.en: It’s quiet and has a nice atmosphere, so it’s worth recommending.

sentences.target: 시간이 오래 걸리지만 해 볼 만한 경험이야.
sentences.en: It takes a long time, but it’s an experience worth trying.

sentences.target: 어려워 보이지만 차근차근 하면 할 만해.
sentences.en: It looks difficult, but if you take it step by step, it’s doable.

sentences.target: 비용이 들긴 하지만 시도해 볼 만한 프로젝트야.
sentences.en: It costs money, but it’s a project worth attempting.

sentences.target: 첫인상은 강하지만 알고 보면 이야기할 만한 사람이야.
sentences.en: His first impression is strong, but once you know him, he’s worth talking to.

sentences.target: 노력이 필요하지만 충분히 성과가 날 만해.
sentences.en: It takes effort, but it’s something that can produce real results.

sentences.target: 멀긴 하지만 한 번쯤 방문할 만한 곳이야.
sentences.en: It’s far, but it’s a place worth visiting at least once.

sentences.target: 준비만 잘하면 누구나 도전할 만해.
sentences.en: With good preparation, anyone can give it a try.
